name: plataine-ai-agents
description: Connects Claude to Plataine's Total Production Optimization suite of AI Agents.
long_description: Ask Claude what a disruption means for your factory. Plataine's AI Agents compute an optimized response from live production data, and actions that need approval are shown in Claude before they run. Every request runs with your own TPO permissions and is recorded in the TPO audit trail.
